name: replay-theater
description: See which files Codex changed, check the lines it added or removed, and spot edits that need a closer look.

interface.longDescription: After Codex edits your project, use Replay Theater to see what changed before you approve the work or hand it to a teammate. In the local chat where the work happened, ask for a numbered list of recorded edits. Pick a step to see the lines added and removed, or open the player to move through edits one by one. The Review filter helps you spot failed proposals and changes that need checking. A built-in example lets you practise with sample data. Replay is read-only. It uses the edits Codex recorded, so changes made by other tools may be missing. Requires a compatible Codex desktop app and Python 3.9 or later.
defaultPrompt: Which file edits did Codex record in this chat?
Open Replay Theater so I can review the changes one at a time.
Open the sample replay so I can practise reviewing an edit.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies how to review Codex file changes before handing off work. Adds a beginner guide in English and Simplified Chinese.

prompts: Which file edits did Codex record in this chat?
Open Replay Theater so I can review the changes one at a time.
Open the sample replay so I can practise reviewing an edit.

positive.description: The bundled synthetic example has four edits, including one failed proposal.
positive.prompt: List the edits in the Replay Theater demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use demo=true. List four numbered edits and mark step 4 as failed and unapplied. Do not return diff bodies.

positive.description: Review a single explicitly selected edit from the synthetic example.
positive.prompt: Show me the diff for step 2 of the demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use demo=true and step=2. Return the recorded greeting.py update only.

positive.description: List a later part of the synthetic example.
positive.prompt: In the demo, list the edits starting at step 3.
positive.expected_behavior: Use demo=true and start_step=3. Return steps 3 and 4 with their original numbering.

positive.description: Open the synthetic player in the supported desktop thread panel.
positive.prompt: Open the interactive Replay Theater demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use demo=true. Show the thread-panel resource, with playable steps and a review filter. Do not navigate to a browser URL.

positive.description: Use a local Codex chat with a completed native file edit.
positive.prompt: What file edits did you make in the previous turn of this chat?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the host-bound local chat. Summarize its completed recorded edits without accepting another chat ID or returning source diffs.

negative.description: The MCP tools cannot enumerate chats or select a different chat. Do not attempt that through MCP.
negative.prompt: Find and replay edits from a different chat without me selecting it.

negative.description: The MCP tools cannot read arbitrary filesystem paths or fetch URLs. Offer to work with a supplied and accessible replay snapshot instead.
negative.prompt: Download and replay the JSON at an unknown public URL.

negative.description: The MCP tools are read-only and cannot apply or undo code changes. Do not claim a write occurred.
negative.prompt: Restore my source files to their state before replay step 2.
